notes.type_correctness: All types are consistent. The delta-spec used 'mode' but implementation correctly renamed to 'playMode' to avoid collision with the pre-existing 'gameMode: GameMode' field — documented in tasks.md. All 7 state return paths in updateGameState include both new fields. TypeScript build passes with zero errors.
notes.pattern_adherence: Sprint panel follows the exact same show/hide pattern as PauseModal and GameOverOverlay. setPlayMode() uses the same cache-invalidation pattern (lastX = -1) as existing HUD fields. startGame() helper correctly mirrors the restartGame() teardown order (audio → menu destroy → key listener). One minor deviation: the spec's section 7.3 described a separate 'onPlayStart' callback but the implementation keeps the existing flushActions()/GameAction.Start path for Marathon — better design, not a regression.
notes.test_coverage: persistence.ts achieves 100% branch coverage. gameState.ts Sprint paths covered via 8 dedicated Sprint tests for both hard-drop and gravity-lock paths, timerStarted edge, line cap, and marathon non-interference. HUD setPlayMode and updateSprintTimer are tested. GameOverOverlay showSprint/hide reset tested with 7 scenarios. main.ts Sprint wiring (timer start/stop, PB comparison) is not unit tested — acceptable as main.ts is excluded from the coverage threshold.
notes.security: All localStorage access in persistence.ts is wrapped in try/catch. No new network I/O or user-supplied data paths. localStorage key is a hard-coded constant. PB comparison uses strict numeric inequality with no injection risk.
notes.architectural_alignment: Import boundaries clean: persistence.ts has zero imports. HUD imports formatSprintTime from engine/persistence.js. GameOverOverlay imports formatSprintTime from engine/persistence.js. main.ts imports loadSprintPB/saveSprintPB from engine/persistence.js. No renderer/input/ui cross-imports in engine files. playMode field is engine-layer; wall-clock timer state is main.ts-only — respects the pure-engine contract.
